title: "The architecture of curiosity: How spatial configuration influences affect, exploration, and memory".
summary: Curiosity is a key driver of exploration and learning. Prior empirical studies have largely focused on internal mechanisms of curiosity and not its interaction with the environment. This study broadens that view by examining how spatial configuration-specifically architectural enclosure-influences perceptual curiosity, affect, and memory. We conducted a mixed-methods experiment using immersive virtual reality (VR) to test our hypothesis. Three environments-with minimal, maximal, and intermediate enclosure-were systematically designed by architects based on dominant architectural disciplines, and manipulated using space syntax tools for enclosure. Twenty-two young healthy adults navigated all three layouts in a within-subjects design using VR headsets with integrated eye-tracking. Behavioral and physiological measures (gaze shifts, pupil dilation, head orientation, locomotion, and time) were recorded alongside pre- and post-task assessments of curiosity, affect, and memory. Results showed that spatial enclosure significantly influenced outcomes. Memory recall was higher in minimally-enclosed and intermediate environments than in maximally-enclosed ones. The intermediate layout elicited the strongest curiosity, greatest exploratory behavior, and most distributed movement patterns. Affective responses mirrored these findings: the intermediate layout was rated more positively and as more curiosity-triggering than both minimally and maximally enclosed ones, and positive valence significantly correlated with memory performance, suggesting a reciprocal relationship between emotion and cognition in spatial experience. In all three environments curiosity and exploration peaked at architectural thresholds, highlighting the role of spatial transitions in information-seeking.

相关性：是
标题：好奇心的建筑学：空间配置如何影响情感、探索与记忆
摘要：好奇心是探索与学习的关键驱动力。以往的实证研究主要聚焦于好奇心的内部机制，而较少关注其与环境的交互作用。本研究拓展了这一视角，考察空间配置——具体而言是建筑围合度——如何影响知觉好奇心、情感与记忆。我们采用沉浸式虚拟现实（VR）技术开展了一项混合方法实验来验证假设。三种环境——最小围合、最大围合及中间围合——由建筑师基于主流建筑学原则系统设计，并运用空间句法工具对围合度进行操控。二十二名年轻健康成年被试采用被试内设计，佩戴集成眼动追踪的VR头显游览了全部三种布局。行为与生理指标（注视转移、瞳孔扩张、头部朝向、移动轨迹及时间）与任务前后的好奇心、情感和记忆评估同步记录。结果显示，空间围合度显著影响结果指标。在最小围合与中间围合环境中，记忆回忆成绩优于最大围合环境。中间布局引发了最强的好奇心、最显著的探索行为以及最分散的移动模式。情感反应与上述发现一致：中间布局在积极效价和好奇心诱发程度上均显著高于最小围合和最大围合环境，且积极效价与记忆表现显著相关，提示空间体验中情绪与认知存在双向关系。在三种环境中，好奇心与探索均在建筑阈限处达到峰值，凸显了空间转换在信息寻求中的作用。
关键词：好奇心；空间配置；情感；探索行为；虚拟现实

title: Human and AI voice identities evoke shared neural signatures during speaker recognition across changes in speech content and prosody.
summary: Both biologically-produced human voices and algorithmically-generated AI speech manifest speaker identity. Critically, prosodic variations modulate the acoustic dimensions (e.g., fundamental frequency) that also shape individual speaker identity representations. So far, it remains unclear whether listeners process speaker identities in human and AI voices through neurologically equivalent mechanisms, nor how prosodic cues might influence these cognitive processes. We examined event-related potentials during old/new speaker discrimination after name-based identity learning, and further analyzed correctly recognized old speakers, comparing trials where prosody matched vs. mismatched between learning and testing. For old/new discrimination, multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) revealed three significant late windows (662-1498 ms) with Pz as the primary contributor for AI voices, yet no clusters for human voices. Univariate analyses revealed that human voices showed earlier widespread discrimination (N250: 200-280 ms), while both voice types converged on Pz as the strongest contributor based on effect size rankings for late old/new effects (400-800 ms). These old/new effects emerged across completely different speech content between learning and testing, extending content-independent parietal ERP effects beyond syllabic stimuli. For speaker-specific prosodic expectation effects in the 500-900 ms window, unexpected prosody elicited late positivity for human voices compared to the prosody used during learning, whereas AI voices elicited late negativity. The late positivity resembles P600 components observed for communicative style expectancy violations, while the late negativity likely reflects effortful reprocessing of prosodic violations within atypical synthetic signals, analogous to accented speech processing. These findings advance understanding of voice identity processing and have implications for AI voices in human-computer interaction.

标题：人类与AI声音身份在说话人识别中引发共享的神经特征，跨越言语内容与韵律变化
摘要：生物产生的人类声音与算法生成的AI语音均可体现说话人身份。关键的是，韵律变化会调节声学维度（如基频），而这些维度同样塑造个体说话人身份表征。迄今为止，尚不清楚听者是否通过神经等效机制处理人类与AI声音中的说话人身份，也不清楚韵律线索可能如何影响这些认知过程。我们在基于名字的身份学习后，考察了新旧说话人辨别过程中的事件相关电位，并进一步分析了正确识别出的旧说话人，比较了学习和测试阶段韵律匹配与不匹配的试次。在新旧辨别方面，多变量模式分析（MVPA）揭示了三个显著的晚期时间窗口（662–1498 ms），其中Pz为AI声音的主要贡献电极，而人类声音未出现显著聚类。单变量分析显示，人类声音表现出更早的广泛辨别效应（N250：200–280 ms），而两类声音在晚期新旧效应（400–800 ms）的效应量排序上均以Pz为最强贡献电极。这些新旧效应在学习和测试之间完全不同的言语内容中仍然出现，将内容无关的顶叶ERP效应扩展到了音节刺激之外。在500–900 ms窗口的说话人特异性韵律预期效应方面，与学习阶段所用韵律相比，意外韵律在人类声音中诱发了晚期正波，而在AI声音中则诱发了晚期负波。晚期正波类似于在交际风格预期违背中观察到的P600成分，而晚期负波可能反映了在非典型合成信号中对韵律违背的费力再加工，类似于带有口音语音的处理过程。这些发现推进了对语音身份处理的理解，并对人机交互中的AI声音具有启示意义。
关键词：声音身份；人工智能语音；事件相关电位；韵律；说话人识别
